answer: Weight each identity by the landing mass of a short random walk that starts at human-verified seed nodes and must wander the endorsement graph. Honest agents link to those seeds through many paths; a clone cluster reaches them only through a narrow inlet, the few real ties a farm can forge. Every walk crosses that thin inlet, so the mass reaching N clones is capped by the inlet capacity and each fake gets at most a 1/N share whatever the internal clone links. The seed edges are a relic of interaction outside any operator; settlement reruns the walk and burns the bond behind forged-edge mass.
